segments.t: After a tense screen test with Gerard Lanvin, young actor Samy panics and fails to impress the production team. While Camille fights passionately to protect her new client, Mathias insists on cutting losses to preserve the film. Let's listen to the scene in French first.

Il ne sait pas encore jouer.
Nous devons penser à ce film.

Mais nous allons continuer ensemble.
